requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

803-1486-4231-5400--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Synth Infiltrator. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

176-4875-6798.easyPrerequisites:
Conspiracy has any type chosen that isn't "Spirit".
You control another creature.
176-4875-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token. The token won't be a Soldier due to Conspiracy.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

339-677-7175-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7175-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-2586-3197.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat

5078-6791-6918-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

978-997--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1874-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ajani's Welcome trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1874-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-5477-7297.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

862-5220-6798-6900.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-1379-4853-5147.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2946-4050-5632.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4050-5632.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Repeat.

826-2364-3767-3918.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Mana Vault's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

3384-4067-5042-6827.easyPrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
3384-4067-5042-6827.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, tapping Spider-Gwen.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw four cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.

4775-6553-6798.easyPrerequisites: Necrogen Communion attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
4775-6553-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

4017-5641-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4017-5641-6720.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2292-4484-4871-5643-6556.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6556.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2292-4484-4871-5643-6556.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

759-1247-4178-5963-6549.description:
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' second ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

3231-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
3231-4120-4968.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

1793-5147-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1793-5147-6249--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Harvester of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Harvester of Souls trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1429-1477-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-1477-5402-5929.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

3476-5145-5256-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1792-2608--63.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Derevi that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1792-2608--63.description:
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting any creature you control except Derevi that does not have summoning sickness.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted in step 1.
Resolve Retraction Helix.
Cast the permanent from your hand by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Resolve the permanent spell.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning the permanent cast in step 5 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.

943-1376-1399-4235.notablePrerequisites:
Priest of Titania does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
943-1376-1399-4235.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding {G} for each Elf on the battlefield.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, targeting Priest of Titania.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Wirewood Lodge's ability, targeting Priest of Titania.
Resolve the first Wirewood Lodge ability, untapping Priest of Titania.
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding {G} for each Elf on the battlefield.
Resolve the second Wirewood Lodge ability, untapping Priest of Titania.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Wirewood Lodge.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Wirewood Lodge.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may repeat steps 7 through 9 targeting any other land you control instead, or repeat the combo targeting any Elves you control.

1806-2034-4875-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
"Sliver" chosen with Conspiracy.
1806-2034-4875-5072.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Eternal Scourge's encore ability by paying {3} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating a token copy of it with haste for each opponent you have.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Eternal Scourge tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets infinite Eternal Scourge tokens with haste and colorless mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2265-3693-4120.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2265-3693-4120.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
2265-3693-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

225-539-765-1257.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Walking Atlas as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

1247-3099-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-3099-4474.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding {G} and one mana of any color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding two mana of any one color.
Repeat.

1953-2105-2969.description:
Cast Zndrsplt's Judgment by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

306-2103-2493.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Cache Raiders triggers, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
